findings.issue: A full AF_UNIX accept backlog could indefinitely block the startup stale-socket probe while Session held its instance lock.
findings.resolution: Linux startup now calls host::connect_until with one 500 ms absolute deadline. Only ConnectionRefused can remove a stale socket; timeout, unconnected and other errors preserve it.
findings.regression: ui/session/tests/organ_broker.rs:255-307 creates actual listen(0) full queues for both session.sock and organ.sock, requires bounded unsuccessful child exit, and checks the exact original dev/ino remains.

verified_boundaries: Kernel peer credentials are obtained before reading an Organ request; claimed UID, PID, role and numeric session ID cannot substitute.

The original frame is bounded to MAX_FRAME+1 and read through EOF before typed serde deserialization and session admission. Unknown fields, nested duplicate fields, second lines and trailing malformed input remain rejected.
Every accepted exchange uses the same single-owner Broker and explicitly closes its session before attempting the reply write. Transport errors do not trigger retry or invent non-submission.

Absolute read/write deadlines are recomputed from one fixed Instant; progress and interrupted syscalls cannot reset it. Client connect is included, and peer_addr rejects an unconnected descriptor after readiness.
The original host schema/commands, private directories, instance lock and only-ConnectionRefused stale recovery are preserved. Both listeners are polled once per single-owner iteration.
Existing Broker effect capabilities remain default-deny, drafts LocalOnly and unsupported reconciliation Unknown. This is not production HOS2 effect authority or completion of issue 111.
Cargo lock contains the three new local dependency edges without an external package version update.
remaining_qualification: Exact 0e4a source final native tests and negative controls have not yet run, according to owner handoff. Earlier 73-test execution covers an earlier source only.
Source review does not establish a hard real-time CPU scheduling guarantee or new bound for future blocking Broker handlers. Current Broker handle paths inspected are synchronous bounded local logic.
